id: 36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S
title: 给安全从业者的刁钻选择题
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/36_Tricky Safety MCQs for Safety Professionals Logical HSE Questions with Answers S/src.py

points.K2: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
points.K3: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
points.K4: 测过气，作业中还要复测
points.K9: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
points.K11: 明知故犯是不安全行为

shots.scene: 欣欣托着下巴思考，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rubs its chin thoughtfully with question marks floating above its head, then waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 看起来安全，真的安全吗？
overlay: 给安全从业者的刁钻选择题

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地举起答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student confidently holds up a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这些题，一看就会。

shots.scene: 小研笑着摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：小心，每题都有陷阱。

shots.scene: 十张题卡排成一排，每张四个空白选项
shots.prompt_en: Ten quiz cards in a row, each with four blank option boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 十道四选一，都是逻辑陷阱题。

shots.scene: 面试桌前，老周向阿杰提问
shots.prompt_en: At an interview table, the older man asks the young male student a question.
shots.narration: 面试时，常会问到这类题。

shots.scene: 一扇门上挂着空白绿牌，门后是坑
shots.prompt_en: A door with a blank green sign; behind the door, a hidden hole in the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 表面条件满足，不等于真的安全，要动脑想。

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 老李穿着全身式安全带在高处作业
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works at height wearing a full body harness.
shots.narration: 第一题：穿了全身式安全带，就完全安全？
overlay: 穿了安全带还要看挂点

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B：挂点也必须安全可靠。

shots.section_title: 穿了安全带还要看挂点
shots.scene: 挂钩挂在一根细管子上打叉，结实的钢梁挂点圈出
shots.prompt_en: A hook clipped to a thin pipe is crossed out; a sturdy anchor point on a steel beam is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 挂在哪里很关键，挂不牢就接不住人。

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 小密闭房间里电器起火，二氧化碳灭火器对准
shots.prompt_en: In a small closed room, a carbon dioxide extinguisher nozzle is aimed at a burning electrical panel. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：小房间里用二氧化碳扑电气火？
overlay: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 隐藏危害是B：氧气被置换。

shots.section_title: 小房间用二氧化碳会缺氧
shots.scene: 氧气分子被挤出房间的示意
shots.prompt_en: Oxygen molecule icons being pushed out of a small room by gas clouds. No people.
shots.narration: 通风差的空间里氧气减少，有窒息危险。

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 老李在有限空间入口外用检测仪测气
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the air at the entrance of a confined space with a gas detector.
shots.narration: 第三题：进去前测过气，作业中还要复测？
overlay: 测过气，作业中还要复测

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B：要，作业中气体环境会变。

shots.section_title: 测过气，作业中还要复测
shots.scene: 时间线上气体浓度曲线突然升高，旁边反应、泄漏、作业三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A timeline graph where a gas level line suddenly rises, beside icons of a chemical reaction, a leak and a tool. No people.
shots.narration: 化学反应、泄漏、作业本身都会改变它。

shots.scene: 电缆外皮开裂，但看不到铜线
shots.prompt_en: An electrical cable with cracked outer insulation, no copper wire visible. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：绝缘破了没露线，能临时用吗？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C：绝缘破损就不安全。

shots.scene: 触电、短路、起火三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an electric shock, a short circuit spark and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 看不到导线，触电、短路、起火风险也在增加。

shots.scene: 老李换上一根新电缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces the damaged cable with a new one.
shots.narration: 要更换，临时用也不安全。

shots.scene: 工地上一条一米深的沟，旁边标尺
shots.prompt_en: A one meter deep trench at a construction site with a measuring pole beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：沟只有1米深，还要安全措施吗？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B：要，危害与深度无关。

shots.scene: 沟边塌落和地下管线被挖坏的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crumbling trench edge and a damaged underground pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 浅沟也会塌方，也会挖坏地下管线。

shots.scene: 1米和1.5米两条沟都标上对勾
shots.prompt_en: Two trenches labeled with green checks, one shallow and one slightly deeper. No people.
shots.narration: 1米也好1.5米也好，都要采取措施。

shots.scene: 老李戴齐防护用品却还是受伤
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears full protective gear but holds his injured head after a small object falls.
shots.narration: 第六题：防护用品穿戴齐全还受伤？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 最可能是B：不合适，或者没用对。

shots.scene: 安全帽下颏带垂着，帽子掉落
shots.prompt_en: A hard hat with its chin strap hanging loose falls off a head silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 比如安全帽不系下颏带，东西一砸就掉。

shots.scene: 老李系好下颏带，帽子戴稳
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens the chin strap so the hard hat fits firmly.
shots.narration: 防护用品要选合适的，并且正确使用。

shots.scene: 起重机吊着箱子，风向标狂转
shots.prompt_en: A crane lifts a crate while a wind vane spins wildly. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：吊重没超安全载荷，但风很大？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C：不安全，天气也影响安全。

shots.scene: 吊物在风中摆动，指挥人员示意停止
shots.prompt_en: The suspended crate swings in strong wind lines while the facility engineer signals stop with raised hands.
shots.narration: 风大吊物不稳会晃，风大就停止吊装。

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 干净的工作场所，通道上散着线缆
shots.prompt_en: A clean and tidy workplace, but loose cables lie scattered across the walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：场地干净，但通道上散着线缆？
overlay: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B：不安全，有绊倒危害。

shots.section_title: 干净不等于安全：线缆绊人
shots.scene: 线缆整理好，通道照明充足
shots.prompt_en: Cables neatly routed along the wall; the walkway is brightly lit. No people.
shots.narration: 好的现场管理，也包括线缆管理和照明。

shots.scene: 老李给设备电源上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer locks out the power switch of a machine and hangs a blank tag.
shots.narration: 第九题：设备上锁后，维修前先做什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B：验证零能量。

shots.scene: 老李按启动键确认设备不动，用测电笔测试
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the start button to confirm nothing moves, then checks with a voltage tester.
shots.narration: 隔离之后，确认没有残余能量，再动手。

shots.section_title: 明知故犯是不安全行为
shots.scene: 阿杰为了省时间，跳过规程步骤
shots.prompt_en: The young male student skips a step on a blank procedure checklist to save time.
shots.narration: 第十题：明知规程，为省时间不照做？
overlay: 明知故犯是不安全行为

shots.section_title: 明知故犯是不安全行为
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 真正的问题是B：不安全行为。

shots.section_title: 明知故犯是不安全行为
shots.scene: 知识图标打勾，旁边规程被跳过打叉
shots.prompt_en: A knowledge book icon with a green check beside a skipped procedure icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 很多事故不是不懂，而是知道却不照做。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，图标：挂点、氧气、检测仪
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of an anchor point, an oxygen symbol and a gas detector.
shots.narration: 挂点要牢，小房间缺氧，作业中复测。

shots.scene: 图标：破电缆、浅沟、安全帽
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a damaged cable, a shallow trench and a hard hat. No people.
shots.narration: 破绝缘不能用，浅沟也防护，防护用对。

shots.scene: 图标：风向标、线缆、锁、人形
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wind vane, a cable, a padlock and a person. No people.
shots.narration: 大风停吊，线缆绊人，验零能量，别图省事。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with a knowing smile.
shots.narration: 多想一步，避开陷阱，下次见！
